steps.name: Internalize
steps.description: Read or listen to the source passage multiple times until you can retell the story or content from memory without looking at the text.

steps.name: Oral Retelling
steps.description: Retell the passage orally in your own words to a partner or small group. This confirms comprehension before translation begins.

steps.name: Discuss Key Terms
steps.description: As a team, identify difficult or important terms in the passage. Agree on how to express them naturally in the target language. Record decisions and rationale.

steps.name: Discuss Exegetical Questions
steps.description: Work through comprehension and interpretation questions about the passage. Resolve ambiguities as a group. Record any key decisions or discussion points.

steps.name: Draft Translation
steps.description: Produce an initial oral translation of the passage. Record it. This is the raw first draft before any review.

steps.name: Self-Review & Revise
steps.description: Listen back to your recording. Check for accuracy, naturalness, and completeness. Re-record if needed. Mark as ready for team review when satisfied.

group_slots.name: Translation Team
group_slots.description: The translator's immediate team. Reviews for accuracy against the source, naturalness in the target language, and completeness.

group_slots.name: Community Panel
group_slots.description: Native speakers from the broader community (not translators). Tests for clarity, naturalness, and whether the meaning is communicated without insider knowledge.

group_slots.name: Comprehension Testers
group_slots.description: People unfamiliar with the source text who listen and retell what they understood. Their retelling reveals comprehension gaps.

group_slots.name: Church Elders
group_slots.description: Local church leaders who validate theological faithfulness and appropriateness for use in worship and teaching.

group_slots.name: Theological Advisor
group_slots.description: A trained consultant (may be remote) who checks for exegetical accuracy and flags potential theological issues.

group_slots.name: Regional Oversight Board
group_slots.description: Final administrative sign-off confirming the translation has passed all prior checks and is authorized for distribution. Typically a denominational or regional body.

group_slots.name: Back-Translation Reviewer
group_slots.description: Verifies accuracy via independent back-translation into a language of wider communication.
